items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: So I told her, I said, well look, as long as I manage him, as long as I'm booking him, you'll get some money from me.

ctx.x: It's been quite some time, you know. Was it Jones or what? Do you think it was? I don't remember. Did he have any brothers or sisters?

I think he had a brother. I think he had one brother. He had a lot of nephews, nieces and what. I can't recall whether he had a sister. I could have met her sister there. I really don't remember. It's been quite some time, you know. Yeah, he might have had a sister. I know he had a brother. I met her brother. A lot of nieces and nephews. I met them. I met cousins and what not. But I remember this lady. I went to her house. The first time we played there, I went to her house and I met her. She sat down and told…
You were one man, through a one man agency. It was Shaw, with a lot of money in the money.
